title: Precise Asymptotics of Non-Convex M-Estimators
abstract: arXiv:2611.30798v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Precise asymptotic theory for M-estimators in high-dimensional settings is largely limited to convex or mildly non-convex formulations, yet non-convex loss functions as well as regularizers are widely used in practice. We study M-estimation in generalized linear models (GLMs) where the loss function or the regularizer can be non-convex. Under rotationally invariant design matrices in the proportional asymptotic regime, we analyze the problem through Vector Approximate Message Passing (VAMP), whose iterates are described by a low-dimensional deterministic recursion called State Evolution (SE). Existing proofs of SE require the proximal operators of the loss function and the regularizer to be Lipschitz, but a non-convex loss or regularizer can have a discontinuous proximal operator, and the usual Onsager terms in VAMP then miss the contribution of the discontinuities. translated_title: 非凸M-估计量的精确渐近性
translated_abstract: M-估计量在高维情形下的精确渐近理论目前主要局限于凸或轻度非凸的公式形式，然而非凸的损失函数和正则化项在实践中被广泛使用。我们研究了广义线性模型（GLM）中的M-估计问题，其中损失函数或正则化项可以是非凸的。在比例渐近区域下，对于旋转不变的设计矩阵，我们通过向量近似消息传递（VAMP）来分析该问题，其迭代过程由一个称为状态演化的低维确定性递归来描述。现有的状态演化证明要求损失函数和正则化项的近邻算子满足Lipschitz条件，但非凸的损失函数或正则化项可能具有不连续的近邻算子，此时VAMP中通常的Onsager项便会遗漏不连续点带来的贡献。假设近邻算子是局部（摘要原文在此处被截断）的特殊函数……
tldr: 该论文突破了现有状态演化理论要求近邻算子Lipschitz连续的限制，通过修正Onsager项以处理非凸损失函数或正则化项导致的近邻算子不连续问题，从而建立了非凸M-估计量在高维广义线性模型中的精确渐近理论。
en_tdlr: This paper extends precise asymptotic theory to non-convex M-estimators in high-dimensional GLMs by modifying the Onsager correction in VAMP's State Evolution to account for the discontinuous proximal operators arising from non-convex losses or regularizers.
